fields.name: Section1
fields.fieldText:
Hello, Is {!varPGFullName} available? Hi {!varFirstName}, my name is {!formulaCurrentUserName}. I’m calling from the Funding Department at National Funding to complete a verbal verification of your signed contract. How are you doing today?



The verification call should only take about 3-5 minutes. Are you available now to complete the call?



Before we begin, I would like to advise you that this call will be recorded for quality control purposes.

fields.name: blankspace
fields.fieldText: br

fields.name: MLP_Terms_and_Conditions_0
fields.fieldText:
Now, I would like to go over the terms of the loan Agreement with you:


We are funding a {!varFundingAmount} loan to the business.

fields.name: MLP_Unsettled_Balance
fields.fieldText: At the time of funding, you will have an unsettled balance of {!varExistingLoanBalance} from your previous loan. You will receive the disbursement amount of {!varNettoCustomer}, which is the difference between the loan amount and the unsettled balance.

fields.name: MLP_Terms_And_Conditions
fields.fieldText: Should you go out the full {!varNumberofPayments} months, the total payback on your loan will be {!varRepayment} however we do encourage you to pay this loan off early as there is no pre-payment penalty. The loan will be paid back with {!varNumberofPayments} monthly payments, withdrawn from your bank account on the {!varDateDay} of each month. The first payment of {!varDailyPayment} will be due on {!varWithdrawMonth1MLP} and if that day falls on a weekend or bank holiday, the payment will be pulled on the next banking day. The second payment will be due on {!varWithdrawMonth2MLP}, the third payment on {!varWithdrawMonth3MLP}, and so on.

fields.name: MLP_Terms_And_Conditions_1
fields.fieldText:
On {!formFundingDateMLP} you will receive {!varFundingAmount} via ACH and on the third banking day you’ll see the origination fee of {!varOriginationFee} withdrawn. Then each month thereafter, the monthly payment will be withdrawn from your account via ACH. 


Do you understand the terms that I outlined to you?

fields.name: MLP_Unsettled_Balance_1
fields.fieldText:
On {!formFundingDateMLP} you will receive {!varNettoCustomer} via ACH and on the third banking day you’ll see the origination fee of {!varOriginationFee} withdrawn. Then each month thereafter, the monthly payment will be withdrawn from your account via ACH. 


Do you understand the terms that I outlined to you?
